articles.title: What Security Leaders Say About the First AI-Developed Zero-Day Exploit
articles.description: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) identified a threat actor deploying a zero-day exploit believed to be developed with AI. This marks the first time GTIG has discovered such a threat, and suggests that newer AI models could be leveraged to create exploits rather than simply discover them.

articles.title: Vadzo Imaging Explains Color Science in Embedded Vision: Achieving Precise Color Accuracy for Industrial and Medical Applications
articles.description: Vadzo Imaging explains how color science and ISP processing impact color accuracy in embedded vision systems used for industrial, medical, and autonomous applications. The release highlights the Falcon-821CRS and Falcon-1335CRS USB camera products designed for HDR imaging, precise color reproduction, and real-time image optimization. The company demonstrates how reliable color fidelity improves performance across robotics, medical imaging, kiosk vision, drone cameras, and smart surveillance systems.
